title.narrative: Integrated Livelihood and Protection Support (ILPS) -Empowering Displaced Women in South Sudan

description.narrative:
The South Sudan Hub project ideation activities will be implemented by WFC with overall technical and coordination support from CTP, alongside engagement from hub members and the host. A structured team will ensure effective delivery, accountability, and compliance. Strategic oversight will be provided by the Hub Coordinator, while WFC will lead day-to-day implementation through the Project Coordinator, who will supervise staff, manage workplans, and ensure adherence to project and donor requirements.
At the field level, the Field Facilitator will drive community engagement by mobilizing participants, conducting regular sessions, and supporting case follow-ups. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) functions will be led by the MEAL Officer, who will conduct routine monitoring, track indicators, document lessons, and support adaptive management through evidence-based feedback.
Clear reporting lines will enhance efficiency, with the Field Facilitator reporting to the Project Coordinator, while the MEAL Officer provides independent updates to both the Project Coordinator and senior management. Operational coordination will be maintained with camp leadership, local authorities, and GBV actors to ensure safe and conflict-sensitive implementation. Continuous engagement with protection stakeholders will strengthen referral pathways, safety assessments, and alignment with community systems, supported by regular coordination meetings.
